mode: built-in image_gen; edit; opaque floor tile
processing: Nearest-neighbor sampling; palette matched to existing floor; exact original two-pixel border and central seam cross (x=14..17 or y=14..17); original variant pixels retained outside this seam mask; Point filtering at 32 PPU.

variants.name: branching_crack
variants.variation: Add one readable but restrained forked hairline crack within the upper-right flagstone, with a tiny chip where it branches. Other stones remain mostly intact. Crack stops well before the tile border.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one production seamless 32 x 32 pixel-art stone FLOOR tile for a 2D dungeon.
Image 1 is the edit target and exact style, palette, scale and layout reference. Redraw a compatible variation of this same floor.
Keep the tile completely square, flat orthographic top-down, fully opaque and filled edge to edge. No margin, frame, bevel around the outside, isolated floating object, perspective view, wall, furniture, labels or text.
Keep the familiar broad indigo flagstones and the mortar joins where they meet the edges: vertical edge joins meet at the midpoint and horizontal edge joins meet at the midpoint. The outer TWO logical pixels on every edge must remain visually identical to the reference, so this tile connects to old and new tiles in every direction. Put the variation INSIDE the tile, never across an outer edge.
Keep exactly the reference's dark low-contrast indigo palette: main stone approximately RGB 56,60,86; deep blue-gray joints and cracks; tiny restrained edge highlights. No warm colors, green moss, gold, white highlights, directional cast shadows, glossy surfaces or bright blue glow.
Pixel-art craft: genuine hand-drawn 32 x 32 logical pixels, one-pixel details, deliberate square pixel clusters, stepped cracks, no antialiasing, no smoothing, no soft gradients, no blur, no subpixel details.
Delivery: a true 32 x 32 opaque PNG if possible; otherwise an exact 32x nearest-neighbor enlargement on a 1024 x 1024 canvas of the 32 x 32 logical artwork. Each logical pixel is one flat square. Only one tile, no sheet or preview layout.
Variation for this tile: Add one readable but restrained forked hairline crack within the upper-right flagstone, with a tiny chip where it branches. Other stones remain mostly intact. Crack stops well before the tile border.

variants.name: chipped_junction
variants.variation: Give the four inner corners around the central mortar junction different small chips and worn notches, with two tiny embedded stone fragments. Keep the large stone faces mostly intact and avoid a large hole.
